hook.name: AdvancedFeeHookV6
hook.description: Token launch hook for the BaseStonk launchpad on Base that collects configurable buy/sell taxes (up to 10%) in afterSwap, distributing fees between a platform treasury, creator payees, an optional burn address, and optional single-sided liquidity positions. Includes a time-limited sniper-protection window with elevated buy fees decaying linearly to the base rate.
